verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents API versions (v1/v2/v3 OpenAPI specs) and mentions v3 as the current required version for PATs, showing some version evolution exists, but there is no documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline, versioning changelog, or migration guidance for older API versions. missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy/timeline documentation, version support lifecycle statements, migration guides between versions, changelog of breaking changes.
